verdict.rationale: The only evidence is community source-code inspection. It says the browser extension sends anonymous telemetry by default, and that this can be disabled only from the Proton account settings, not in the extension itself. No first-party documentation in the pack describes a telemetry opt-out, and the user reports the telemetry was not covered in the privacy policy. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the telemetry opt-out, an in-client (extension/app) toggle, clarity on which clients and what data the account-level setting covers, independent hands-on confirmation that disabling stops transmission.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: telemetry data is anonymous, but it's always sent to the remote endpoint, and the only way to disable it is from your Proton account, not the extension itself.
It can only be disabled from the Proton account, not in the extension itself
